definition: ConcreteAt ex concrete x w means ex x w and concrete x w. Existence and a theory-relative concreteness criterion are independent supplied predicates. No causal-powers, spatiotemporal or independence/actuality account is endorsed. Absence of concrete individuals is an empty extension at an existing world, not an empty world type. Abstract-object status is not inferred from failing this predicate.
